text: The Medical Officer of Health will give a presentation on Update on Toronto's Respiratory Viruses Season.

Th Board of Health: 1. Requested the Medical Officer of Health to report to the Board of Health at the earliest possible opportunity with an update on the following: a. Update on progress related to directions set out in Item 2022.HL35.8, "Bringing a Public Health Lens to Indoor Ventilation Requirements", on ventilation; and b. Update on progress related to directions set out in Item 2022.HL39.1, "Update on COVID-19 Response and Other Public Health Issues", on masking.
